messages:
maria: Heads-up: I'm proposing a migration plan to a sparse/compact trace envelope at ingress to reduce payload volume (~3x) and lower egress costs. Outline below, want quick sanity check on cost attribution and late-enrich interactions.
aj: +1 to cost reduction goals. Curious — how do we preserve attribution keys for billing when we drop spans?
maria: plan is to keep a compact keyset: trace_id, billing_key (if present), top_level_span_meta (error/latency flags), and a lightweight span index for reconstruction. Full spans stored in S3/backfill for on-demand rehydration.
kevin: Concern: queries that reconstruct sampled traces will be heavier. What's the expected query latency hit?
maria: we expect ~10-20% extra CPU on reconstruct path for rare queries. Most dashboards read compact envelopes, only deep debug uses rehydration.
olga: How about late enrichment? If enrichment adds billing keys post-ingest we need to ensure the compact envelope can carry enrichment tokens or a resolvable pointer.
maria: right — we plan to include an enrichment pointer (enrich_ptr) that maps to enrichment queue ID. Late-enrich workflow will patch billing_key into compact envelope via our enrichment index.
sam: Will sampling rules change? if we reduce size we could sample more aggressively.
maria: sampling proposed: keep head sampling semantics but add adaptive tail-sampling for errors. Draft snippet:
```json
{"sampling": {"default_rate": 0.01, "error_rate": 1.0, "latency_threshold_ms": 500, "tail_adaptive": true}}
```
aj: That config looks fine. Need a migration window and feature flag. Also telemetry to measure reconstruction QPS & cost.
maria: migration steps: 1) opt-in compact envelopes behind FF for 10% of tenants; 2) run parallel full-span write for 30d; 3) measure query shape, recon cost, and billing delta; 4) ramp to 100% with backfill option. Rollback via FF.
kevin: Add a canary for the enrich pointer resolution service. If enrich_ptr lookup fails we'll fallback to full span fetch.
olga: For cost attribution, we must ensure billing_key propagation is not lost during prefix sampling. Add an integration test that simulates late enrich + prefix cache eviction.
deploy-bot: @maria Canary listener deployed to staging at sha abc123 — logs under /staging/compact-migration. :rocket:
maria: Nice. Action items: aj - add telemetry counters (recon_latency_ms, recon_cpu_ms, compact_payload_bytes); kevin - implement fallback path; olga - write integration tests for billing propagation; i'll draft migration RFC and runbook.
aj: On it. I'll also add a Grafana board and alert if recon tail latency > 2s.
kevin: ETA on fallback patch by EOD tomorrow.
olga: I'll schedule a short follow-up sync Thu 9am. Want to catch edgecases with edge-proxy compression.
maria: thanks all. If no objections I'll post the RFC this afternoon.
